CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Co.fr: Une BOÎTE À JETONS est requise...

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Fa.fr: J'adore ce PORYGON ! Mais c'est dur\nde gagner aux machines à sous !
CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Fa.en: I sure do fancy that PORYGON!\nBut, it's hard to win at slots!

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Ne.fr: Désolé, il te faut plus de JETONS\nque ça.
CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Ne.en: Sorry, you'll need more COINS\nthan that.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Ra.fr: Gahaha ! J'ai ramassé le pactole\naujourd'hui ! Si seulement chaque\pjour était comme ça...
CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Ra.en: Gahaha! I raked it in today!\nIf only every day were like this…

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_We.fr: Nous échangeons tes JETONS contre\ndes lots.
CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_We.en: We exchange your COINS for prizes.

CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Yo.fr: D'accord, tu veux la CT de\n{STR_VAR_2} ?
CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Yo.en: Okay, a TM of {STR_VAR_2}\nis what you want?
